description: BD Topo - Pylone is a dataset listed in Tarn et Garonne Open Data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by IGN. Ce jeu de données détaille les adresses présentes dans le thème Adressage de la BD TOPO. La version BD TOPO correspond à la version publiée par l'IGN en décembre 2021. Coverage: Tarn-et-Garonne. The portal files it under Données territoriales. Its keywords are bd topo, ign, pylone. The portal shows 2,201 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2022-04-05 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-82amenagement-fr-portal.
